properties.name: app.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Enables Kafka-driven email event consumption. When false, Kafka listeners should remain disabled for this service.

properties.name: app.kafka.consumer-group
properties.description: Kafka consumer group id used by the email service when consuming application events

properties.name: app.kafka.config-broadcast-group
properties.description: Kafka consumer group id used to invalidate local caffeine cache

properties.name: app.email.cache-name
properties.description: Name of the Java class to be cached

properties.name: app.email.cache-ttl
properties.description: Time-to-live for cached email runtime configuration entries.

properties.name: app.email.retry.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of retryable email records to pick up in a single entry batch.

properties.name: app.email.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts before an email is considered exhausted and moved to final failure handling.

properties.name: app.email.retry.initial-delay-ms
properties.description: Initial retry backoff in milliseconds before the first resent attempt.

properties.name: app.email.retry.max-delay-ms
properties.description: Upper bound for retry backoff in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.email.retry.scheduler.enabled
properties.description: Enables the background scheduler that scans for retryable email work.

properties.name: app.email.retry.scheduler.poll-delay-ms
properties.description: Polling interval in milliseconds for the retry scheduler.

properties.name: app.email.topics.email-to-send
properties.description: Kafka topic that carries outbound email send events.

properties.name: app.email.topics.email-config-changed
properties.description: Kafka topic that notifies the email service that instance configuration has changed

properties.name: app.email.sender.connection-timeout-ms
properties.description: SMTP connection timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.email.sender.timeout-ms
properties.description: SMTP read timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.email.sender.write-timeout-ms
properties.description: SMTP write timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.clients.instance-service.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the instance-service used by the email service to resolve instance-scoped runtime configuration.

properties.name: app.clients.instance-service.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout for HTTP calls to instance-service.

properties.name: app.clients.instance-service.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for HTTP calls to instance-service.

properties.name: app.observability.otel.logback.enabled
properties.description: Enable OpenTelemetry logging

properties.name: app.response-cache.enabled
properties.description: Enable response caching

properties.name: app.data.jpa.auditing.enabled
properties.description: Enable JPA auditor aware

properties.name: app.web.access-logging.enabled
properties.description: Enable request logging
